title: anthoxanthum novae-zelandiae
intro: Anthoxanthum novae-zelandiae, commonly known as New Zealand sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of New Zealand sweet grass may include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit potential neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
